items.title: Show HN: I made a tool that turns Jetpack Compose Previews to embeddable scripts
items.desc: If you are an Android Developer this is for you. I love interactive previews on my Jetpack Compose websites but adding them is a PITA. So I built a little tool turns your @Composable @Preview into an embeddable `<script />` that you can add to your documentation, blog posts and any sites.
items.author: alexstyl
items.descZh: 本文针对 Android 开发者，特别是使用 Jetpack Compose 的用户，解决了一个痛点：在网站上添加交互式预览非常繁琐。该工具的核心功能是将 @Composable @Preview 转化为可嵌入的 <script /> 标签，允许开发者轻松将其集成到任何网页中。其最大亮点在于将原本复杂的预览部署工作简化为简单的脚本引用，极大地提升了文档和博客的交互式展示效率。该工具适用于技术文档、个人博客以及任何需要展示 Compose 实时交互效果的 HTML 网站场景。
items.quote: 所以我做了一个小工具，可以将你的 @Composable @Preview 转换为可嵌入的 <script />，方便你将其添加到文档、博客文章和任何网站中。

items.author: alexander2002
items.descZh: 本产品是一个基于GitHub仓库星数的实时猜测游戏，背景源于对开源项目流行度的趣味探索。核心功能是让玩家在隐藏星数的情况下，选择两个仓库中星数较高的一个，通过“higher or lower”机制进行挑战。亮点在于使用GitHub API获取真实星数数据，并设有分数系统，例如玩家可追踪最佳得分（如Best: 0）和当前得分（如Score: 0），提升游戏的可玩性和竞争性。适用场景包括GitHub用户、开发者或开源爱好者在休闲时游玩，既能娱乐又能了解社区趋势。
items.quote: 一个基于 GitHub API 真实星标数的“猜高猜低”游戏。

files Repository files navigation [](/5TN1rcZRS79VAEFuUCRB/MCPersist/blob/main/common/src/main/resources/mcpersist%5Ficon.png) MCPersist _e4mc, but your world keeps running after you leave._ MCPersist v2 is a Fabric, NeoForge and Forge mod based on [e4mc](https://github.com/vgskye/e4mcminecraftarchitectury). Like e4mc, it puts your LAN world on the internet at an address your friends can join with an unmodded client. It also lets you mark a world as persistent. When you leave that world, or close the game, it keeps running as a headless server in the background on your machine, and it keeps the same address every time. Status: alpha. Built for Minecraft 26.3\. Expect rough edges. AI disclosure. MCPersist is written with heavy use of AI (Claude, which shows up in the contributors list). I decide what it does and test it ingame with friends, but most of the code and text is AIwritten. Back up your worlds. If you'd rather not use AIassisted software, that's fair: [e4mc](https://github.com/vgskye/e4mcminecraftarchitectury), which this is forked from and which doesn't accept AI contributions, is a good choice when you don't need the world to keep running. Joining a world Shared worlds use a whitelist. Before a friend joins for the first time, the host runs /whitelist add <name. The background server uses the same whitelist, as it was when the host left: manage it while you're playing, since changes made on the background server are replaced at the next handoff. Anyone can join with an unmodded client: they just type the world's address. Their connection is carried by the MCPersist relay, which adds a bit of latency. [](/Chaarangan/stepgate/blob/main/LICENSE) Agents can't skip steps. Write an agent's procedure once, as a YAML stepfile, and every step is gated: the agent moves on only when a mechanical check passes, never on its own word. One file runs anywhere. A stepfile has no packages, no versions to pin and no code to deploy, so it moves as a single file to any MCP client, such as Claude Code, Cursor or an agent you wrote, and runs on the model that client already uses. A stepfile declares its inputs, the remote APIs and MCP servers it may call, and an ordered list of steps. Each step says what output it must produce and which gates check that output. The file names no model and no framework. Stepgate runs stepfiles. It is an MCP server that offers each stepfile as a tool. When a client's agent calls it, Stepgate shows the agent one step at a time, makes every API call the step needs, and moves on only when the step's gates pass. Make the procedure you already wrote enforceable A skill or runbook written as markdown tells an agent what to do, and the agent decides how much of it to follow. Here is one: name: packagenotes description: Writes an upgrade note for each npm package, with versions taken from the registry. 1. Look up each package's latest version on the npm registry. 2. Write a oneline upgrade note for each. Never state a version the registry did not return. stepgate_outline turns it into a skeleton, and the finished stepfile makes both lines binding. Stepgate does the lookup itself, so the agent never fetches or copies a version. The agent only writes the notes, and a gate rejects any note whose version differs from what the registry returned, naming the rows that broke it: stepgate: "1" id: packagenotes description: Writes an upgrade note for each npm package, with versions taken from the registry. inputs: type: object required: [packages] properties: packages: { type: array, minItems: 1, maxItems: 20, items: { type: string, pattern: "^[az09][az09._]$" } } tools: npm: openapi: server: https://registry.npmjs.org document: openapi: 3.1.0 info: { title: npm registry, version: "1" } paths: /{name}/latest: get: operationId: getLatest parameters: [{ name: name, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }] exposes: [getLatest] steps: id: lookup do: calls: id: latest operation: getLatest each: { var: inputs.packages } arguments: { name: { var: item } } output: packages: { map: [{ var: responses.latest }, { object: [[name, { var: name }], [latest, { var: version }]] }] } produces: type: object required: [packages] properties: { packages: { type: array }
items.author: charangan
items.descZh: Stepgate 是一款针对 AI Agent 执行流程约束不足而设计的 MCP 服务器，旨在通过“不可跳过步骤”的机械闸门机制，将松散的 Markdown 运营手册转化为强约束的可执行逻辑。它将流程定义为纯 YAML 格式的 stepfile，声明输入、外部 API 及有序步骤，无需部署代码或管理包版本，仅需单文件即可在任何 MCP 客户端（如 Claude Code、Cursor）上运行。核心亮点在于“闸门（gates）”机制，Agent 在调用下游 API 后，必须通过预设的机械校验才能进行下一步，彻底杜绝了模型凭空捏造或跳过步骤的行为。以 `packagenotes` 步骤文件为例，它限制输入包数量在 1 至 20 个之间（正则校验格式），自动向 npm 仓库查询最新版本，并由 Agent 生成升级备注，任何版本不匹配的输出都会被具体点名并拒绝。该工具适用于需要高可靠性、严格合规性以及多步骤外部系统集成的自动化工作流，如发布管理、自动化测试和批量数据同步。
items.quote: 智能体不能跳过步骤：一个在客户端自己的模型上运行受限制的、仅限 API 的步骤文件的 MCP 服务器。
items.titleZh: 展示 HN：Stepgate——无法跳过步骤的 AI 代理，集成于一个便携文件中

items.author: ajat82
items.descZh: 随着AI代理的普及，传统无头浏览器在访问部分网站时面临约20%的Cloudflare 403拦截率，而托管式隐身浏览器则存在将用户隐私数据路由至第三方云端的风险。Ghostfox提供了一套可完全自托管且开源的AI原生隐身浏览器方案，核心由指纹一致性Firefox引擎与Rust MCP运行时无缝集成。其最大亮点在于拥有自主维护的Firefox引擎分支，通过C++底层补丁实现引擎级反检测，而非传统的JS注入，从而提供更深层的防指纹追踪能力。该方案采用Rust运行时管理会话与身份，结合原生MCP支持与一致性身份审计功能，构建了坚实的技术壁垒。它特别适用于对数据隐私、身份一致性及反爬虫免疫力有极高要求的AI自动化代理、安全审计和大规模数据采集场景。
items.quote: 智能体原生隐身浏览器 — 指纹一致性 Firefox 引擎 + Rust MCP 运行时。自托管，开源，引擎级防检测。
items.titleZh: 展示一下：Ghostfox —— 面向 AI 代理的自托管隐匿浏览器

items.title: Show HN: Novrl, clickable product demos from screenshots, no account needed
items.desc: description: Turn a few screenshots into a clickable product demo. Drop a hotspot on each one, publish, and share a link or embed it. No account needed. title: novrl · Interactive product demos from screenshots image: https://novrl.com/og.png No account, no install Interactive product demos from screenshots Upload a few screenshots, drop a hotspot on each one, and publish. You get a shareable link and an embed snippet in about two minutes. 1 Upload screenshots 2 Drag a hotspot on each 3 Publish and share [See a finished demo below](how) Build your demo Frame theme Light Dark Demo title Shows in the frame, on the page title and when the link unfurls. Steps 0 of 12 Drop screenshots here or tap to choose · PNG, JPG, WebP, HEIC No step selected Drag to draw the hotspot · drag the box to move it · drag a corner to resize Upload a screenshot to start. Then drag on it to mark the spot people should click. Tooltip Step title (optional) Appears above the tooltip text. Live preview This is exactly what visitors see Publish demo Your demo is live Share link Copy Embed snippet Copy Private edit link Copy Save this link somewhere safe. It is the only way to edit or delete this demo, there is no account to log back into, and it is shown once. Video Download MP4 Rendered in your browser, nothing uploaded. Set the pacing, the size and the cards first; it quotes the length before it starts. Needs Chrome or Edge on desktop. Your demo carries a small Made with novrl badge. Take it off for USD 5 for this demo, USD 29 for every demo you make. Remove the badge [Start another demo](/) Advertisement How novrl works A product demo does not need a recording studio. Most of the time a handful of screenshots, one clear instruction per screen, and a link you can paste into a reply is enough to show someone what your product does. novrl takes the screenshots you already have, puts them in a browser frame, and adds a pulsing hotspot with a tooltip on each one. Visitors click through at their own pace. There is nothing to install, no account to create, and the demo works on a phone. novrl.com/d/15n59n7rIG Click the pulsing hotspot to move through it. This is a real novrl demo, made in the editor above and dropped in here with its own embed snippet. Klovra, the app in the screenshots, is invented. [Open it on its own page](/d/15n59n7rIG). Every published demo comes with a line like this one: <iframe src="https://novrl.com/e/15n59n7rIG" width="100%" height="600" style="border:0;borderradius:12px" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"</iframe What you can use it for A clickable walkthrough in a cold email or a reply on X An onboarding tour embedded in your docs or help centre Showing a feature to a customer without booking a call A quick before and after for a redesign Bug reports and internal handoffs that need context Questions Do I need an account? No. You build the demo, publish it, and get a link. The private edit link that comes back is your only key to that demo, so keep it somewhere you will find it again. How many steps can a demo have? Up to 12\. Each screenshot is resized to 1600 px wide and converted to WebP, or JPEG on Safari, in your browser before it is uploaded, so demos stay fast to load. Is my demo private? No. Anyone with the link can open it, and the screenshots sit on public storage. Do not upload anything with real customer data, credentials or anything else you would not put on a public page. Can I embed it on my own site? Yes. Every published demo comes with an iframe snippet. The embed drops the header and share bar and keeps the demo itself. How do I delete a demo? Open your private edit link and press Delete. If you lost the link, send the demo URL through the [contact page](/contact) or DM [@Dylveloper](https://x.com/Dylveloper) on X. What does it cost? Nothing to make, share or download a demo. Every demo carries a small Made with novrl badge, and taking it off is optional: USD 5 for one demo or USD 29 for every demo you make, still no account. Ads on this page cover the hosting. items.author: dylan_builds
items.descZh: novrl 是一款创新的轻量级工具，旨在无需注册和安装的情况下，直接在浏览器中将静态产品截图转化为交互式、可分享的点击演示。其核心操作流程极简，用户只需上传截图（最多 12 步，最大宽度 1600px 并在本地转为 WebP 格式），拖拽添加热点与提示框，即可一键发布并获取分享链接或嵌入代码。该工具的亮点在于完全本地化的渲染技术，支持在 Chrome 或 Edge 桌面端将演示直接生成为本地 MP4 视频，保障了处理速度与隐私。它广泛适用于冷邮件中的交互式导览、官方文档中的嵌入式新手引导、无需预约会议的客户功能展示，以及需要直观上下文的 Bug 报告和内部交接。基础版本完全免费，用户可选择支付 5 美元或 29 美元去除品牌水印，但需注意公开链接的存储性质，避免上传敏感数据。
items.quote:
我可以帮你把截图做成一个可交互的演示页面。你只需要把截图发给我，再告诉我一些基本的交互逻辑——比如点击哪些区域会跳到哪张图、希望有什么动画效果、整体的风格偏好等等。

有截图和这些细节之后，我就能直接给你生成对应的 HTML 代码了。
